REPORT zcomposite_sql_form.
DATA gv_total TYPE i.
DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zsflight WITH DEFAULT KEY.
FORM add_value USING iv_value TYPE i CHANGING cv_total TYPE i.
  ADD iv_value TO cv_total.
ENDFORM.
START-OF-SELECTION.
PERFORM add_value USING 1 CHANGING gv_total.
SELECT * FROM zsflight INTO TABLE @lt_flights ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
  WRITE / ls_flight-carrid.
ENDLOOP.
